```{r setup}
#| echo: false
#| eval: true

library(tidyverse)
```

Three types of palettes:

1.  discriminate

2.  qualitative

3.  smooth

Okabe

```{r plot normal color}
mpg %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = displ, y = hwy)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = class)) +
  geom_smooth()
```


```{r plot OkabeIto}
mpg %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = displ, y = hwy)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = class)) +
  geom_smooth() +
  paletteer::scale_color_paletteer_d("colorblindr::OkabeIto_black")
```
